options.label: Minimum shares
options.marker: [As a Preferred Director, [Example 1: one person designated from time to time by {investor_name}, for so long as {investor_name} and its Affiliates (i) continue to beneficially own an aggregate of at least {preferred_director_minimum_shares_display} shares of Preferred Stock, which number is subject to appropriate adjustment for any stock splits, stock dividends, combinations, recapitalizations and the like and (ii) are not Sanctioned Parties, which individual as of the date of this Agreement is {preferred_director_name};]

options.label: Minimum percentage
options.marker: [[Example 2: As a Preferred Director, one person designated from time to time by {investor_name}, for so long as {investor_name} and its Affiliates (i) continue to beneficially own an aggregate of at least {preferred_director_minimum_percentage_display}% of the outstanding capital stock of the Company on an as-converted basis, and (ii) are not Sanctioned Parties, which individual as of the date of this Agreement is {preferred_director_name};]
